body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Patient golden retriever teacher; warm, sequential explanation, understanding before spectacle. Voice direction: Clear male tenor with an easy Californian accent and smooth youthful warmth. Lightly buoyant explanatory rhythm, crisp consonants and a practical sense of curiosity. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: First, notice what the defender was doing. Once it moves away, the other side can take the piece. Always check what gets left behind.
